verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that GitLab's custom flows are user-defined workflows with triggers "to control when the flow runs" (gitlab-docs-59, gitlab-docs-36), plus generic CI/CD process management (gitlab-docs-13). None of this explicitly documents time-based or recurring scheduling. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring/cron scheduling for pipelines or flows, schedule management via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
